entities.name: UniProt O07003
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Bacillus subtilis 168 levanbiose-producing levanase.
Annotated to degrade levan mainly into levanbiose; reference annotation states it is not active on sucrose.
Reference localization: cell membrane, single-pass membrane protein; sequence contains an N-terminal hydrophobic segment.
Pfam domains: Glyco_hydro_32N at residues 48–356 and Glyco_hydro_32C at residues 360–510.
Sequence length 516 aa; calculated mass about 58.98 kDa and theoretical pI 5.18.
